info.name: Form API
info.description: Happy-path run of every Form API endpoint. Headers (Bearer JWT, X-Tenant-Id, X-Organization-Id, X-User-Id, X-Software-Id, X-Request-Id) are assigned automatically by the collection pre-request script. Every request must return 200.

exec: // Assigns Authorization + trusted-context headers on every protected request.
// Negative tests set an "X-Test-Mode" header (removed before sending) to tamper with the identity.
const payload = { sub: v('userId'), tenant_id: v('tenantId'), organization_id: v('organizationId'),
roles: v('roles').split(','), iss: v('jwtIssuer'), aud: v('jwtAudience'), iat: now, exp: now + 300 };
const unsigned = enc({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }) + '.' + enc(payload);
const set = (k, val) => pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: k, value: String(val) });
pm.test('createdBy is the token subject', function () { pm.expect(json.data.createdBy).to.eql(pm.variables.get('userId')); });
